name: Coquina
tagline: Run a real food brand from one shared kitchen
positioning: Coquina gives solo chefs and food entrepreneurs the delivery-only kitchen, ordering menus, and logistics to launch a brand without a storefront.

hero.h1: Your kitchen is ready. Your brand starts tonight.
hero.sub: Coquina rents you a licensed prep station, plugs you into every delivery app, and handles the packaging and pickups — so one person can run a real food business.

features.title: A station you can actually afford
features.description: Rent a licensed, inspection-ready prep station by the shift or the month. No lease, no build-out, no six-figure deposit before your first order.

features.title: One menu, every app
features.description: Publish once and Coquina syncs your menu, hours, and pricing to DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Grubhub. Update a dish and it changes everywhere in seconds.

features.title: Packaging that shows up
features.description: Compostable containers, labels, and inserts stocked at your station and reordered before you run out. Your brand on every bag, no minimums.

features.title: Prep math done for you
features.description: Coquina reads your incoming orders and tells you how many portions to batch, when to start, and what to prep tomorrow. Less waste, fewer 86s.

features.title: Couriers handled at the door
features.description: Drivers check in at a single pickup window with order codes, so you cook instead of chasing the right bag to the right car.

features.title: Your numbers, honestly
features.description: One dashboard for sales, refunds, and food cost across every platform — the real margin per dish, not a screenshot from three apps.

testimonials.quote: I was making birria out of my apartment and getting nowhere. Six weeks after moving into a Coquina station I was doing 90 orders a night, alone, and actually keeping the money.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

testimonials.quote: The menu sync alone saved my sanity. I used to update prices on three apps at midnight. Now I change one thing at Coquina and forget about it.
testimonials.name: Daniel Okafor

testimonials.quote: I test a new dish on Thursday and drop it if it flops on Sunday. Coquina lets one person move like a whole restaurant group.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar
